tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.description: Return the wallet's token balances on a given chain. Reports both gross balance and spendable (net of reserve) for every token the treasury tracks on that chain.

session_key.description: Session key ID issued by grant().

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID (e.g. 1 for mainnet, 84532 for Base Sepolia).

token.description: Token EVM address (address(0) = native ETH). If omitted, returns all tokens on the chain.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Execute a payment from the agent wallet to a payee. Enforces the active SpendPolicy (token allowlist, per-tx cap, daily cap, counterparty allowlist) before co-signing.

session_key.description: Session key ID authorising the payment.

amount.description: Amount in token base units (wei / USDC decimals).

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata attached to the payment.

tools.name: create_escrow
tools.description: Create a new on-chain escrow entry for a payment. Returns an escrow_id the payee uses to confirm or release funds.

tools.name: confirm_payment
tools.description: Confirm and release an in-flight escrow once the payee has delivered the agreed service. The escrow is released to the payee.

tools.name: request_refund
tools.description: Request a refund of an escrowed payment. Valid only when the escrow is in the Locked state and the challenge period has passed, or the payee has agreed to the refund.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the refund request.

tools.name: policy_status
tools.description: Return the current spend-policy status for a session key: remaining per-tx cap, remaining daily cap, expiry time, and whether the key is still active.

tools.name: escrow_metrics
tools.description: Return aggregated escrow-fulfilment metrics: fill rate, average time-to-release, timeout rate, refund rate, challenge rate, and current pending count.

chain_id.description: Filter metrics to this chain. Omit for all chains.
